The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc:
Artus wears the Ring of Winter. He and the ring can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors. While attuned to and wearing the ring, Artus ceases to age and is immune to cold damage and the effects of extreme cold.

Artus wields Bookmark a +3 dagger with additional magical properties. As a bonus action, Artus can activate any one of the following properties while attuned to the dagger, provided he has the weapon drawn:

- Cause a blue gem set into the dagger's pommel to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet, or make the gem go dark.
- Turn the dagger into a compass that, while resting on your palm, points north.
- Cast dimension door from the dagger. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
- Cast compulsion (save DC 15) from the dagger. The range of the spell increases to 90 feet but it targets only spiders that are beasts. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Artus makes three attacks with Bookmark or his longbow.

actions.name: Bookmark (+3 Dagger)
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: rw 5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target {@h}6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ring of Winter
actions.desc:
The Ring of Winter has 12 charges and regains all its expended charges daily at dawn. While attuned to and wearing the ring, Artus can expend the necessary number of charges to activate one of the following properties:

- Artus can expend 1 charge and use the ring to lower the temperature in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 300 feet of him. The temperature in that area drops 20 degrees per minute, to a minimum of −30 degrees Fahrenheit. Frost and ice begin to form on surfaces once the temperature drops below 32 degrees. This effect is permanent unless Artus uses the ring to end the effect as an action, at which point the temperature in the area returns to normal at a rate of 10 degrees per minute.
- Artus can cast one of the following spells from the ring (spell save DC 17) by expending the necessary number of charges: Bigby's hand (2 charges) the hand is made of ice, is immune to cold damage, and deals bludgeoning damage instead of force damage as a clenched fist, cone of cold (2 charges), flesh to stone (3 charges); as flesh to stone except that the target turns to solid ice with the density and durability of stone, ice storm (2 charges), Otiluke's freezing sphere (3 charges), sleet storm (1 charge), spike growth (1 charge) the spikes are made of ice, or wall of ice (2 charges).
- Artus can expend the necessary number of charges and use the ring to create either an inanimate ice object (2 charges) or an animated ice creature (4 charges). The ice object can't have any moving parts, must be able to fit inside a 10-foot cube, and has the density and durability of metal or stone (Artus's choice). The ice creature must be modeled after a beast with a challenge rating of 2 or less. The ice creature has the same statistics as the beast it models, with the following changes: the creature is a construct with vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to cold and poison damage, and immunity to the following conditions: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned. The ice creature obeys only its creator's commands. The object or creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Artus. It melts into a pool of normal water after 24 hours or when it drops to 0 hit points. In extreme heat, it loses 5 (1d10) hit points per minute as it melts. Use the guidelines in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to determine the hit points of an inanimate object if they become necessary.

actions.name: Wall of Ice {@recharge}
actions.desc:
The devil magically forms an opaque wall of ice on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall is 1 foot thick and up to 30 feet long and 10 feet high, or it's a hemispherical dome up to 20 feet in diameter.

When the wall appears, each creature in its space is pushed out of it by the shortest route. The creature chooses which side of the wall to end up on, unless the creature is incapacitated. The creature then makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the devil is incapacitated or dies. The wall can be damaged and breached; each 10-foot section has AC 5, 30 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. If a section is destroyed, it leaves behind a sheet of frigid air in the space the wall occupied. Whenever a creature finishes moving through the frigid air on a turn, willingly or otherwise, the creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The frigid air dissipates when the rest of the wall vanishes.

traits.desc:
A faerie dragon's scales change hue as it ages, moving through all the colors of the rainbow. All faerie dragons have innate spellcasting ability, gaining new spells as they mature.

Red—5 years or less

Orange—6–10 years

Yellow—11–20 years

Green—21–30 years

Blue—31–40 years

Indigo—41–50 years

Violet—51 years or more

A green or older faerie dragon's CR increases to 2.

actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Ebondeath that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this Ebondeath's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

actions.name: Possession {@recharge}
actions.desc:
One humanoid that Ebondeath can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Ebondeath; Ebondeath then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Ebondeath now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Ebondeath can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, including gaining access to the target's knowledge, class features, and proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Ebondeath ends it as a bonus action, or Ebondeath is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Ebondeath reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to Ebondeath Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

Heartstone.
This lustrous black gem allows a night hag to become ethereal while it is in her possession. The touch of a heartstone also cures any disease. Crafting a heartstone takes 30 days.

traits.name: Confusing Gaze

When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the umber hulk and is able to see the umber hulk's eyes, the umber hulk can magically force it to make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw, unless the umber hulk is incapacitated.

On a failed saving throw, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a d8 to determine what it does during that turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action but uses all its movement to move in a random direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes one melee attack against a random creature, or it does nothing if no creature is within reach.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the umber hulk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the umber hulk in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

vampire.name: Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc:
If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.desc:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from Holy Water (Flask), this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 18).

The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

traits.name: Loathsome Limbs
traits.desc:
Whenever the zombie takes at least 5 bludgeoning or slashing damage at one time, roll a d20 to determine what else happens to it:

1–8: One leg is severed from the zombie if it has any legs left.

9–16: One arm is severed from the zombie if it has any arms left.

17–20: The zombie is decapitated.

If the zombie is reduced to 0 hit points, all parts of it die. Until then, a severed part acts on the zombie's initiative and has its own action and movement. A severed part has AC 8. Any damage it takes is subtracted from the zombie's hit points.

A severed leg is unable to attack and has a speed of 5 feet.

A severed arm has a speed of 5 feet and can make one claw attack on its turn, with disadvantage on the attack roll. Each time the zombie loses an arm, it loses a claw attack.

If its head is severed, the zombie loses its bite attack and its body is blinded unless the head can see it. The severed head has a speed of 0 feet. It can make a bite attack, but only against a target in its space.

The zombie's speed is halved if it's missing a leg. If it loses both legs, it falls prone. If it has both arms, it can crawl. With only one arm, it can still crawl, but its speed is halved. With no arms or legs, its speed is 0 feet, and it can't benefit from bonuses to speed.

Each creature in that area that isn't a Plant must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a target takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.desc: If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the horse can make another attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The froghemoth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Shock Susceptibility
traits.desc: If the froghemoth takes lightning damage, it suffers two effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The froghemoth makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks, and it can use Tongue.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc:
mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the froghemoth, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns.

The froghemoth's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the froghemoth takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the froghemoth must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the froghemoth. If the froghemoth dies, any swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the froghemoth can't use this tentacle on another target. The froghemoth has four tentacles.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.desc: The froghemoth targets one Medium or smaller creature that it can see within 20 feet of it. The target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the froghemoth.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: A devourer doesn't require air, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devourer makes two Claw attacks and can use either Imprison Soul or Soul Rend, if available.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Imprison Soul
actions.desc: The devourer chooses a living Humanoid with 0 hit points that it can see within 30 feet of it. That creature is teleported inside the devourer's ribcage and imprisoned there. While imprisoned in this way, the creature is restrained and has disadvantage on death saving throws. If the creature dies while imprisoned, the devourer regains 25 hit points and immediately recharges Soul Rend. Additionally, at the start of its next turn, the devourer regurgitates the slain creature as a bonus action, and the creature becomes an undead. If the victim had 2 or fewer Hit Dice, it becomes a zombie. If it had 3 to 5 Hit Dice, it becomes a ghoul. Otherwise, it becomes a wight. A devourer can imprison only one creature at a time.

actions.name: Soul Rend {@recharge}
actions.desc: The devourer creates a vortex of life-draining energy in a 20-foot radius centered on itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.desc: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
actions.desc: The drow attempts to magically summon a yochlol with a 30 chance of success. If the attempt fails, the drow takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage. Otherwise, the summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 10 minutes, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

traits.name: Antimagic Shell
traits.desc:
The snail has advantage on saving throws against spells, and any creature making a spell attack against the snail has disadvantage on the attack roll.

If the snail succeeds on its saving throw against a spell or a spell's attack roll misses it, the snail's shell converts some of the spell's energy into a burst of destructive force if the spell is of 1st level or higher; each creature within 30 feet of the snail must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) force damage per level of the spell on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The snail makes five Flail Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Flail Tentacle
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Scintillating Shell (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The snail's shell emits dazzling, colored light until the end of the snail's next turn. During this time, the shell sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet, and creatures that can see the snail have disadvantage on attack rolls against it. In addition, any creature within the bright light and able to see the snail when this power is activated must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the light ends.

actions.name: Shell Defense
actions.desc: The flail snail withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it gains a +4 bonus to its AC and is restrained. It can emerge from its shell as a bonus action on its turn.

traits.name: False Appearance

actions.name: Claws

actions.desc:
The kobold uses one of the following options (choose one or roll a d8); the kobold can use each one no more than once per day:

- The kobold hurls a acid (vial). rw 4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. {@h}7 (2d6) acid damage.
- The kobold throws a Alchemist's Fire (flask). rw 4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. {@h}2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of the target's turns. The target can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.
- The kobold throws a small basket into a 5-foot-square space within 20 feet of it. A Swarm of Centipedes with 11 hit points emerges from the basket and rolls initiative. At the end of each of the swarm's turns, there's a 50 chance that the swarm disperses.
- The kobold throws a clay pot full of green slime at the target, and it breaks open on impact. rw 4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d10) acid damage, and the target is covered in slime until a creature uses its action to scrape or wash the slime off. A target covered in the slime takes 5 (1d10) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.
- The kobold throws a clay pot into a 5-foot-square space within 20 feet of it, and it breaks open on impact. A swarm of rot grubs (in this book) emerges from the shattered pot and remains a hazard in that square.
- The kobold makes a melee attack with a scorpion tied to the end of a 5-foot-long pole. mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
- The kobold releases a skunk into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. The skunk has a walking speed of 20 feet, AC 10, 1 hit point, and no effective attacks. It rolls initiative and, on its turn, uses its action to spray musk at a random creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, or it retches and is incapacitated for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that doesn't need to breathe or is immune to poison automatically succeeds on the saving throw. Once the skunk has sprayed its musk, it can't do so again until it finishes a short or long rest.
- The kobold throws a small bag into a 5-foot-square space within 20 feet of it. A Swarm of Wasps with 11 hit points emerges from the bag and rolls initiative. At the end of each of the swarm's turns, there's a 50 chance that the swarm disperses.

The creature can use the reaction three times, after which this gift goes away. The leprechaun can revoke this gift from a creature at any time (no action required). A creature can benefit from only one leprechaun's Gift of Luck at a time.

reactions.name: Astonishing Luck
reactions.desc: When the leprechaun fails an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw, it can roll a new d20 and choose which roll to use, potentially turning the failure into a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. On a failed save, the target begins to hallucinate and is afflicted with a short-term madness effect (determined randomly or by the DM; see "Madness" in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide). The effect lasts 10 minutes.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.desc: If the mammoth moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the mammoth can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. {@h}29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.desc: Tiax has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Tiax wears a Ring of Resistance that grants him resistance to radiant damage.

actions.name: Touch of Decay
actions.desc: ms 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}37 (6d10 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Unholy Firebolt
actions.desc: Tiax causes unholy fire to flare up in a creature's space within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage.

golem-oculaire.name: Dragonbone Golem
languages: understands Draconic and the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: Each creature of the golem's choice that starts its turn within 20 feet of the golem must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw unless the golem is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this golem's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes one Pinion attack and two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Pinion
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is pinned beneath the bony pinion and restrained. The golem has two pinions, each of which can restrain one target. If a creature is restrained by one of the pinions, the golem can't attack with it. Any creature restrained by a pinion can free itself at the start of its turn with a successful DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Petrifying Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: The golem emits a 60-foot cone of petrifying gas from its mouth. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) poison damage and be restrained as it begins to turn to stone. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends on the target. On a failed save, the target is petrified.

haugbui.name: Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc:
If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.desc:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from Holy Water (Flask), this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc:
The vampire has the following flaws:

- 
- 
- 
-

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. {@h}7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of swarm of bats or swarm of rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call 3d6 wolf instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Unarmed Strike
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire makes one unarmed strike.

legendaryActions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire makes one bite attack.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The koalinth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Martial Advantage
traits.desc: Once per turn, the sergeant can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the sergeant that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sergeant makes two melee attacks with its trident.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Hooked Net
actions.desc: rw 4 to hit, range 10/30 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is restrained. A creature can use its action to make a DC 12 Strength check to free itself or another creature in a hooked net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 12) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

reactions.name: Spear the Helpless (2/Day)
reactions.desc: Whenever a creature within 30 feet of the sergeant becomes restrained, the sergeant can move its speed toward the restrained creature. If the sergeant ends its move within reach of the restrained creature, it can make a melee attack against it.

horakh.name: Boss Augustus
languages: Thieves' cant (can't speak in wolf form)

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Augustus regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Augustus dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Augustus wields a +2 Longsword.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Augustus makes any combination of two Bite, Claw, or Magic Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}26 (5d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with Player Characters as Lycanthropes. While cursed in this way, the target retains its alignment, languages, and equipment but otherwise uses the werewolf stat block, excluding actions that require equipment the target doesn't have. During any night when there's a full moon in the sky, the target becomes an NPC under the DM's control and remains so until the night ends. A Remove Curse spell or similar magic ends this curse.

actions.name: Claw (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Magic Longsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}28 (4d10 + 6) slashing damage.

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: The archon's weapon attacks are magical. When the archon hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.desc: The archon can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its understanding of justice.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: One Being
traits.desc: Though it appears as a humanoid creature riding a mount, an archon is a single being. The "rider" can't be dismounted, and no other means can separate the two portions of the archon's being short of its death.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The archon makes two attacks: one with its sword and one with its claws.

actions.name: Sword
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

traits.name: Fear of Fire
traits.desc: If the yeti takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The yeti has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Snow Camouflage
traits.desc: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The yeti can use its Chilling Gaze and makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Chilling Gaze
actions.desc: The yeti targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the yeti, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw against this magic or take 21 (6d6) cold damage and then be paralyzed for 1 minute, unless it is immune to cold damage. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target's saving throw is successful, or if the effect ends on it, the target is immune to this yeti's gaze for 1 hour.

actions.name: Cold Breath {@recharge}
actions.desc: The yeti exhales a 30-foot cone of frigid air. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spore servant makes two hook attacks.

actions.name: Hook
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.desc: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the minotaur can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

monolithique-valet.name: Animated Coffin
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (can't see beyond this radius)
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the animated coffin is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the coffin move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the coffin is animate.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The animated coffin can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The animated coffin makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Entrap
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, if the target is not an Undead, the target has the restrained condition and takes 14 (4d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The animated coffin can grapple only one creature at a time.

traits.name: Raking Charge
traits.desc: If the kavu moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the kavu can make one rend attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. {@h}23 (4d8 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

traits.name: Gruumsh's Fury
traits.desc: The orc deals an extra 4 (1d8) damage when it hits with a weapon attack (included in the attacks).

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}11 (1d6 + 3 plus 1d8) piercing damage, or 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

serpent-de-mer.name: Nightmare Beast
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the beast fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The beast deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The beast makes two Claw attacks and one Tusk attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 (1d12 + 8) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.desc: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Disintegration Gaze {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: The beast targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 70 (10d6 + 40) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this magical effect reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is disintegrated and leaves nothing behind, except a pile of ashes plus whatever equipment it was wearing or carrying.

legendaryActions.name: Tusk Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The beast makes one Tusk attack.

legendaryActions.name: Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The beast moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes two Tusk attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Frightful Howl (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The beast howls as it exhales a cloud of magical fear gas in a 120-foot cone. Any creature in that area must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the beast for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the scarab is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the scarab move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the scarab is animate.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The sahuagin has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.desc: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

traits.name: Shark Telepathy
traits.desc: The sahuagin can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sahuagin makes three attacks: one with his bite and two with his claws or trident.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Horrid Gnashing
traits.desc:
The nullifier's mouths gnash incoherently while it can see any enemies. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the nullifier and can hear it must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Unless the save succeeds, the creature rolls a d8 to determine what it does during the current turn:

- 
- 
-

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The nullifier has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nullifier makes three attacks: one with its bites and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it's a creature. The nullifier has two claws, each of which can grapple one creature.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.desc: The nullifier attempts to interrupt a creature that it can see within 60 feet in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, the nullifier makes a Charisma check with a DC equal to 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.

traits.name: Chromatic Form
traits.desc: When created, the animated breath takes one of five forms, matching its creator's breath weapon: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. This form determines the creature's AC, damage resistance, traits, and attacks.

traits.name: Fire Aura (Fire Form Only)
traits.desc: At the start of each of the animated breath's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the animated breath or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Putrid Aura (Acid and Poison Forms Only)
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the animated breath must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. A creature that touches the animated breath or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The animated breath makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) damage of a type determined by the animated breath's form: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.desc: A creature that touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the pudding corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage. The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.desc: When a pudding that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new puddings if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new pudding has hit points equal to half the original pudding's, rounded down. New puddings are one size smaller than the original pudding.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The pteranodon doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage.

abothid.name: Abothid

traits.name: Poison Cloud
traits.desc: The abothid is constantly surrounded by a cloud of gas that is toxic to non-abothids. Any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or begin suffocating and be stunned for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The abothid makes two tentacle attacks. If it is grappling a creature, the abothid can also use its tongue sting once.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8+3) bludgeoning damage (constriction). If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). The abothid has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Tongue Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack (Dexterity-based): +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be infected with a disease: the injection of a minuscule abothid egg. A humanoid can carry only one abothid egg to term. The egg hatches after 24 hours, producing a larva that climbs to the brain over a number of hours equal to 1d12 + the infected target's Constitution score. During this time, the victim is poisoned and can't regain hit points. Once the larva reaches the brain, the infected target's hit point maximum is reduced by 10 (3d6) per 24 hours. If the larva reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, its transformation into an abothid is complete. Only a wish spell can reverse the transformation.

actions.name: Enslavement (1/Day)
actions.desc: The abothid targets a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the abothid for 1 hour. A charmed target is under the abothid's control and can take no actions except to defend itself to the best of its ability. The abothid can use its telepathy to give orders to the target. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. The effect also ends early if the abothid is destroyed, moves more than 1 mile away from the target, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end it.

actions.name: Psychic Drain
actions.desc: The abothid can feed on the psyche of an enslaved target within 60 feet to regain hit points. It deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage to the target and regains an equal number of hit points. This ability uses all of the abothid's actions for that turn.

abothid.languages: Undercommon, Deep Speech, the racial language of its originating creature

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The amphibian can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Aquatic Advantage
traits.desc: While underwater, the amphibian has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) and Wisdom (Perception) checks, as well as on Dexterity saving throws made to avoid danger. If it swims in a straight line, it can take the Dash action.

traits.name: Hind Legs
traits.desc: The amphibian gains 2 extra claw attacks with its hind legs when it attacks while swimming.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An unarmed amphibian makes 3 attacks: 1 with its bite and 2 with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) slashing damage.

Variant: Armed Amphibian. Amphibians serving an aboleth are sometimes trained to fight with two-handed reach weapons or thrown weapons. In that case, they get only one attack.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Net
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: the target is restrained. It can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature in the net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees a target without harming it and destroys the net.

traits.name: Prey Detection
traits.desc: The cerberus can detect the direction of the nearest Medium warm-blooded creature (or Small, failing that) within half a mile. To do so, it makes a Wisdom (Perception) check opposed by the target's Dexterity (Stealth). If the target is more than 1,000 feet away, the cerberus has disadvantage on its check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cerberus makes three bite attacks, one with each head.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned by the saliva.

actions.name: Tear Apart
actions.desc: If the cerberus hits the same target with multiple bite attacks, each head pulls violently in an opposite direction, trying to tear the victim's body apart. The target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage for each hit after the first in the same turn.

cheval-de-guerre-celeste.name: Celestial Warhorse

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.desc: If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the horse can make another attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Magic Mount
traits.desc: The celestial warhorse extends its necrotic damage resistance to any creature riding it. In addition, it can cast the water walk spell on itself only, and must finish a short rest before it can use this ability again. The celestial horse agrees to serve as a mount only for creatures of Lawful Good, Neutral Good, or Lawful Neutral alignment.

traits.name: Elite Mount
traits.desc: The celestial warhorse is reserved for an elite among paladins: the knights of the oath of perfection. Other characters cannot acquire this mount. A celestial warhorse cannot be bought and is obtained only through a mystical summons. Should another character ride a celestial warhorse, they cannot impose their will on it — the horse decides its own actions.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

cheval-de-guerre-celeste.languages: understands Common and Celestial but can't speak

diaspaad.name: Diaspaad

traits.name: Split
traits.desc: When a Small or larger diaspaad takes at least 25 slashing damage, it splits into two new diaspaads one size category smaller. Each new diaspaad has half the hit points of the diaspaad it split from. They have disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Their damage is reduced by 1 point and one die category per size below Large.

traits.name: Fission
traits.desc: Once per day, if it wishes, a diaspaad can generate another identical diaspaad (same size) by dividing into two parts, each of which regrows into a full creature. The process takes 1 minute, during which the diaspaad is motionless and can do nothing else.

traits.name: Adaptive Damage Resistance
traits.desc: When the diaspaad takes a type of damage, it develops resistance to that damage type for the rest of the combat. Affected damage types are: acid, bludgeoning, fire, lightning, cold, piercing, poison, thunder, slashing. These resistances stack.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The diaspaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and took no damage it wasn't resistant to since the start of its previous turn.

traits.name: Bodily Fusion
traits.desc: Two Medium or smaller diaspaads can merge to reform a diaspaad one size category larger (Large at most). The process takes 1 minute, during which the two diaspaads are pressed together, motionless, and can do nothing else. If uninterrupted, their bodies fuse and reform the "parent" diaspaad at full hit points in 1d3 rounds.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The diaspaad makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Haste (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Until the end of its next turn, the diaspaad gains a +2 bonus to AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and can use its slam attack as a bonus action.

diaspaad.languages: Diaspaad, repeats words without understanding them

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The dref has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Bound Spirit
traits.desc: The dref is bound to a place, a house, an establishment (most often an inn). As long as the place isn't destroyed or consecrated to another purpose, the dref cannot be destroyed. If reduced to 0 hit points, it simply vanishes with a shrill cry (or perhaps a dissonant musical note) and a characteristic foul odor. It reappears 1d4 hours later, as if nothing had happened.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Attack
traits.desc: Once per turn, if the white goblin attacks a creature that has already been attacked by another white goblin this round, it gains either advantage on the attack roll or a +1d6 damage bonus (of the same type as the weapon used).

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The white goblin can take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Mountaineer's Footing
traits.desc: When moving across ice or in mountainous terrain, the white goblin's speed isn't halved.

traits.name: Eye Protection
traits.desc: The white goblin is immune to snow blindness and sees normally in glacial and mountain environments.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The white goblin makes two melee attacks: one with its handaxe and one with its dagger.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Nimble Escape

traits.name: Eye Protection

traits.desc: As a bonus action, the shaman can expend a spell slot to make its melee weapon attacks magically deal an extra 3 (1d6) necrotic damage to a target they hit. This effect lasts until the end of the turn. If the shaman expends a 2nd-level spell slot, the damage increases by 1d6.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The shaman is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): poison spray, chill touch, eldritch blast
1st level (4 slots): bane, cloak of frost

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The white goblin shaman makes two attacks with its club.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

The shaman is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): eldritch blast, resistance, thaumaturgy
1st level (3 slots): command, thunderwave, cure wounds

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Hammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lizardfolk makes three melee attacks, each with a different weapon.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spiked Shield
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.desc: Once per turn, the kobold deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the kobold is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the kobold instead takes no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and that ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Burst Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The rock larva emits a wave in a 10-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 5 (1d10) thunder damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes only half damage and isn't stunned. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: The shaman has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The shaman is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): sacred flame, resistance, thaumaturgy
1st level (4 slots): inflict wounds, shield of faith, command
2nd level (3 slots): spiritual weapon, hold person

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shaman makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Spellcaster Detection
traits.desc: The arcane parasite automatically and instantly detects creatures using spells or magical abilities within 120 feet.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The arcane parasite has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Explosive Death
traits.desc:
When the arcane parasite dies, it explodes, releasing a magical discharge. Each creature within 10 feet takes 3d8 damage of a type depending on the parasite's color, or half as much on a successful DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. Colors and damage types:
1. Red — fire
2. Orange — acid
3. Yellow — lightning
4. Green — poison
5. Blue — cold
6. Violet — thunder
7. White — radiant
8. Black — necrotic

actions.name: Magic Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+2) piercing damage, and the arcane parasite anchors itself to the target with its proboscis, injecting an anesthetizing saliva that makes its bite entirely painless. If the target is unaware of the parasite's presence, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom check to notice the bite. Once attached, the parasite drains one spell slot of the highest level available from the target each round. The parasite usually detaches after draining 1d4+1 spell slots, or if the target has no spell slots left. It can detach by using 5 feet of its movement. The victim or another creature can also detach the parasite by using an action, but the proboscis deals another 5 (1d4+2) piercing damage when torn away.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the willow remains motionless and isn't in bloom, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary tree.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A strangling willow makes as many attacks as there are targets within 15 feet of it. Each creature can be targeted only once per round, either by a strangulation (a branch) or a pin (a root).

actions.name: Pin
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4+5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is restrained unless it succeeds on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Strangle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). A grappled creature can no longer breathe and takes 9 (1d8+5) bludgeoning damage at the start of its turn unless it succeeds on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On its turn, the willow can target an already-grappled creature with a new strangle attack; each successful attack adds another escape check before breaking free. However, the start-of-turn damage doesn't stack — a single saving throw suffices no matter how many branches hold the creature.

traits.name: Rock Explosion
traits.desc: In the first round of combat, if the rock terror was camouflaged behind a rock face and detonates it with its burst wave attack, its foes must succeed on a DC 25 Wisdom (Perception) check or be surprised. The stone shards hurled by the explosion deal an extra 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage in addition to the burst wave's normal damage (see below). A creature that isn't surprised can make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half the damage from the stone projection. The rock terror makes no other attack on a turn in which it detonates a rock face.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rock terror makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its bite, or two with its claws and one burst wave.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Burst Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The rock terror emits a wave in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 11 (2d10) thunder damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes only half damage and isn't stunned. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Akyishigal's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: magic circle, detect evil and good, teleport
3/day each: polymorph (vermin form only), dispel magic, insect plague (as a 6th-level spell)
1/day: contagion (filth fever only)

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Akyishigal has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
traits.desc: Akyishigal can summon one chasme. The demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Akyishigal, acts as his ally, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 1 minute, until Akyishigal dies, or until he dismisses it as an action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Akyishigal makes four claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Cloak of Swarms (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Akyishigal surrounds himself with a cloud of stinging flying insects that pour out of his mouth, eyes, and the sores marking his skin. The cloud surrounds him to a distance of 5 feet. While the cloak is active, attacks against him have disadvantage, and Akyishigal can see in all directions (through the insects' eyes). Any living creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of Akyishigal takes 11 (2d10) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is also poisoned for 1 hour. The swarm persists for 5 rounds. It dissipates instantly if Akyishigal takes 30 damage from an attack that isn't made with a weapon and to which he isn't resistant. While a character is poisoned by the cloak of swarms, the stench of carrion hangs about them. Any vermin not controlled by a creature attacks that character on sight, in preference to all other targets.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.desc: Akyishigal teleports to a spot he can see.

legendaryActions.name: Frenzy Move
legendaryActions.desc: Akyishigal combines an attack with a move of up to 20 feet, as if using the Withdraw action; he doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Akyishigal casts insect plague using his innate spellcasting.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: An ala doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Poisoned Flesh
traits.desc: An ala's flesh is suffused with poison. A creature that hits an ala with a bite attack must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage.

traits.name: Storm Strength
traits.desc: If a thunderstorm is raging near an ala and its target, the target has disadvantage on its saving throw against the ala's lightning kiss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An ala makes two claw attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite

actions.name: Lightning Kiss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: A target within 60 feet must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 28 (8d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: An algorith is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
An algorith's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: aid, detect magic, blur, dimension door
5/day each: dispel magic
1/day each: commune (five questions), wall of force

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An algorith makes two logic-razor attacks.

actions.name: Logic Razor
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12+5) force damage.

actions.name: Cone of Negation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: An algorith projects a cone of null energy. A target in the 30-foot cone takes 42 (12d6) force damage and is subjected to the dispel magic spell. A successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw halves the damage and negates the dispel effect.

actions.name: Reality Bomb (5/Day)
actions.desc: An algorith conjures a tiny rune of law and hurls it as a weapon. Each creature within 30 feet of the square where the reality bomb lands takes 21 (6d6) force damage and is stunned until the start of the algorith's next turn. A successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw halves the damage and prevents the stun.

traits.name: Shadow Born
traits.desc: Each turn, Alquam can take the Hide action as a bonus action when in dim light or darkness, even while being observed by another creature.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Alquam's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: silence, darkness
3/day each: invisibility, fear, teleport
1/day: circle of death

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.desc: Alquam has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Alquam fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Alquam has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Alquam's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Alquam makes one bite attack, one wing attack, and one talons attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d10+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Wing
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8+4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6+4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 17). Alquam can grapple one creature at a time while on the ground, or two while flying. He can't use the talons holding a grappled creature to attack another creature.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: Alquam makes one attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: Alquam flies up to half his flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Shroud (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: A veil of magical darkness radiates from Alquam's body in a 30-foot radius. The darkness persists until the start of Alquam's next turn.

traits.name: Woodland Friend
traits.desc: While in a forest, an alseid leaves no tracks and automatically knows the direction of true north.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
