traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The grove warden is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, guidance, produce flame, shillelagh
1st level (4 slots): animal friendship, cure wounds, faerie fire
2nd level (3 slots): animal messenger, heat metal, lesser restoration
3rd level (2 slots): call lightning, dispel magic

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit (+5 with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) bludgeoning damage, 5 (1d8+1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, or 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/300 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Distress Spores
traits.desc: When an amanita myconid takes damage, all other myconids within 240 feet sense its pain.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the myconid has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. It dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The myconid uses its Amanita Spores or Rapport Spores, then makes one fist attack.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (4d4+1) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (4d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Amanita Spores (3/Day)
actions.desc: The myconid targets a creature it can see within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 3 rounds. While poisoned this way, it takes 10 (4d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Rapport Spores (3/Day)
actions.desc: The myconid targets a creature it can see within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious and be poisoned for 1 minute. An unconscious creature wakes if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: An amphiptere doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Crowd
traits.desc: Two amphipteres can occupy the same space at the same time. An amphiptere sharing its space with a non-incapacitated kin has advantage on its melee attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An amphiptere makes one bite attack and one tail stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: An andrenjinyi can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
An andrenjinyi's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, using verbal components only:
At will: speak with animals, create water, stone shape
3/day each: control weather, dispel magic, reincarnate
1/day each: commune with nature, contagion, plant growth, blight, flesh to stone

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: An andrenjinyi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: An andrenjinyi's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An andrenjinyi makes two attacks, the first with its bite and the second with Constrict. If both attacks hit the same target, that target is swallowed.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12+10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12+10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the andrenjinyi can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Rainbow
actions.desc: As an action, an andrenjinyi can teleport instantly between two sources of fresh water within 1 mile. If it uses this power during a turn, it can't move normally or take any other action that turn. When this power activates, a rainbow appears for 1 minute between the starting point and the destination.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: If an andrenjinyi hits the same target with both its bite and its Constrict in one turn, it swallows that creature. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained and has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the andrenjinyi. An andrenjinyi can hold up to three Medium or four Small creatures at a time. If a swallowed creature deals 20 damage or more to the andrenjinyi in a single turn, the andrenjinyi must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone within 5 feet of the serpent. If the andrenjinyi dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by expending 15 feet of movement, exiting prone. An andrenjinyi can regurgitate swallowed creatures as a free action.

actions.name: Transmuting Gullet
actions.desc: When a creature is swallowed by an andrenjinyi, it must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failure, it is subjected to the true polymorph spell, with the andrenjinyi choosing its new form. This is a permanent effect that can be dispelled or ended only by a wish or similar magic.

traits.name: Shapeshifter
traits.desc: An angel can choose among several forms: a winged celestial form, its original mortal form, and the form of a Medium eagle. Its statistics are the same in each form, apart from the attacks it can make in eagle form.

traits.name: Constant Companion
traits.desc: Faithful angels always know their companion's mood and state of health. Damage dealt to one of them is split between the two; if the damage can't be split evenly, the original target of the attack takes the extra point. Any other harmful effect, such as ability damage, affects both in the same manner.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A faithful angel's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: guidance, spare the dying, light, purify food and drink
3/day: scorching ray (five rays), cure wounds
1/day: enhance ability, bless, detect evil and good, daylight, protection from evil and good, hallow

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: An angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: An angel's weapon attacks are magical while it is in eagle form.

traits.name: By My Love's Side
traits.desc: If separated from its companion, each faithful angel can use plane shift and teleport once per day to rejoin them.

traits.name: Unfailing Loyalty
traits.desc: Faithful angels never willingly part from their companion. No spell or power can compel a faithful angel to act against its companion, and no charm or domination effect can keep them apart or change the love and loyalty they feel for each other.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An angel makes two attacks with its longsword or longbow; in eagle form, it can instead make two talon attacks and one beak attack.

actions.name: Longsword +1 (Mortal or Angel Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8+6) slashing damage, or 11 (1d10+6) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow +1 (Mortal or Angel Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Beak (Eagle Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons (Eagle Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Sand Walk
traits.desc: Instead of moving, an anubian's humanoid form can disintegrate into a heap of sand and reform in another unoccupied space within 10 feet. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. After using this trait in sandy terrain, the anubian can hide as part of this movement, even while being observed. Anubians can use their sand walk to pass under doors or through similar obstacles, provided these have an opening wide enough to let sand through.

traits.name: Water Vulnerability
traits.desc: For every 5 feet an anubian moves in contact with water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 2 (1d4) cold damage. A fully submerged anubian takes 10 (4d4) cold damage at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An anubian makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Haboob (1/Day)
actions.desc: An anubian can create a sandstorm in the shape of a cylinder 30 feet tall with a 5-foot radius that moves with it. Visibility in the sandstorm's area is zero, and any non-anubian creature that enters it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength check or be restrained by it. In addition, any non-anubian creature that ends its turn in the sandstorm takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage. The anubian can maintain the haboob for up to 10 minutes by concentrating as if on a spell. While concentrating this way, its speed is reduced to 5 feet and it can't use its sand walk. Creatures restrained by the sandstorm move with the anubian. A creature can attempt to free itself or an adjacent creature caught in the sandstorm by using an action to make a DC 13 Strength check. On a success, the targeted creature is no longer restrained.

traits.name: Infectious Ichor
traits.desc: Whenever an apau perape takes piercing or slashing damage, a jet of caustic blood sprays from the wound toward the attacker. This jet forms a line 10 feet long and 5 feet wide. The first creature in the line's path must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against disease or become infected with the ichor of Mechuiti disease. The creature remains poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours, the target repeats the Constitution saving throw; on a failure, its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (2d4). On a success, the disease is cured. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction to a creature's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
An apau perape is an innate spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
1/day each: wall of fire, fear

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: An apau perape has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
traits.desc: The apau perape attempts to magically summon a creature of its choice. It has a 50 percent chance of summoning another apau perape or a giant ape.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An apau perape makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings upside down, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) poison damage and be poisoned until the start of the spider's next turn. A creature automatically fails this saving throw and takes an extra 1d6 poison damage if a different red-lined spider bites it while it is already poisoned this way.

actions.name: Diving Line
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: the spider immediately moves the full length of its silk line (up to 60 feet) to reach the target and bites it with advantage. This attack works only if the spider is above its target and at least 10 feet away from it.

traits.name: Unusual Understanding
traits.desc: A spider of Leng can read and use any scroll.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The spider of Leng uses Intelligence as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: comprehend languages, detect magic, shocking grasp
3/day each: shield, silence
1/day each: arcane eye, confusion, hypnotic pattern, stoneskin

traits.name: Poisonous Blood
traits.desc: An attacker that hits a spider of Leng with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Shocking Retort
traits.desc: When a spider of Leng casts shield, it can also make one shocking grasp attack for 9 (2d8) lightning damage against an enemy within 5 feet as part of the same reaction.

traits.name: Ancestral Hate
traits.desc: A spider of Leng reduced to 0 hit points makes one final venom spit attack before dying.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A spider of Leng makes two claw attacks, two staff attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10+3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Venom Spit
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8+3) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned and blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Staff of Leng
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the start of the spider's next turn.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: The sand spider has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings upside down, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Ambush Burrow
traits.desc: When a creature passes over a sand spider's hidden burrow, the spider can use its reaction to attack that creature with two impaling leg attacks; the creature is considered surprised for both attacks. If either or both attacks hit and the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the spider and the target contest Strength. If the target wins, it can immediately move 5 feet away from the spider. On a tie, it is grappled (escape DC 15). If the spider wins, it grapples the target and drags it 30 feet into its lair. If the creature is still grappled at the start of the spider's next turn, it is instead restrained. Once restrained, it can escape by using an action and succeeding on a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sand spider makes two impaling leg attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Impaling Legs
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12+5) piercing damage. If the sand spider scores a critical hit with this attack, roll the damage dice three times instead of twice. If both impaling leg attacks hit the same target, the second hit deals an extra 11 (1d12+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Camouflaged Webs
traits.desc: A DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check is required to spot a j'ba fofi's web. A creature that doesn't notice it and comes into contact with the web is restrained. A restrained creature can free itself by using an action and succeeding on a DC 12 Strength check. The web can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 5 hp, vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

traits.name: Arachnid Sympathy
traits.desc: No ordinary spider attacks a j'ba fofi unless magically controlled or attacked first. In addition, every j'ba fofi is accompanied by a swarm of spiders (a variant of the insect swarm) that moves and attacks at the j'ba fofi's mental direction (directing the swarm costs it no action).

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.desc: While in contact with a web, the j'ba fofi knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw. A target reduced to 0 hit points by this attack is stable but poisoned and paralyzed for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points.

traits.name: Specter Walk
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the specter spider turns invisible and intangible. This invisibility doesn't end when it attacks. While invisible, the spider has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and gains the following benefits: resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons; immunity to the paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, and stunned conditions. The specter walk ends when the spider ends it as a bonus action or when it dies.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement (Specter Walk Only)
traits.desc: The specter spider can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The specter spider makes two bite attacks. It can make one phantom snare attack in place of a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is stable but poisoned and paralyzed for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points. While the spider is using its specter walk, its bite and poison deal half damage to targets not affected by a phantom snare (see below).

actions.name: Phantom Snare (Specter Walk Only, Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: the target is restrained by a ghostly web. While restrained this way, it is invisible to all creatures except specter spiders and has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage. A creature restrained by a phantom snare can escape by spending an action and succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check. The web strands can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 5 hp).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The thief spider is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The thief spider has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Assisted Leap
traits.desc: If its barbed line attack is available, the spider can use its movement to leap 20 feet in a direction of its choice, trailing the line like a strand of web. The line anchors to an object, and the spider reels itself in immediately. It can carry up to 25 extra pounds when moving this way. This kind of movement doesn't count as spending the barbed line attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thief spider makes two sickle-claw attacks.

actions.name: Sickle Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8+1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Barbed Line (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 10). Instead of moving, the thief spider can retract the barbed line and pull itself onto the grappled creature (it enters and stays in that creature's space). The spider's sickle claw attack has advantage against a grappled creature in the same space. If the grappled creature breaks free, the spider immediately moves into an occupied space within 5 feet.
